title: 说好的微辣呢
setting: Chongqing, a hotpot place under a flyover, 9:30 pm.

waiter.name: 服务员
waiter.en: a waiter in a red apron

bro.name: 邻桌大哥
bro.en: the big guy at the next table

steps.zh: 特辣锅底来了，慢慢吃哈！

steps.narr: You ordered mild. One bite of tripe, and your mouth's on fire. 🔥
steps.zh: 你点的可是微辣！一口毛肚下去，嘴巴像着火了。

say.en: Call the waiter back. It's far too spicy!
say.gloss: Excuse me! It's way too spicy!
say.tip: 太……了 = too...: 太辣了 = way too spicy. 辣死我了 = 'the spice is killing me', the standard exaggeration.

mistakes.note: 热 rè is hot as in temperature. Hot as in spicy is 辣 là.

ok.zh: 太辣了？你点的就是特辣呀。
ok.en: Too spicy? Extra hot is what you ordered.

miss.en: Spicy? Have some broth, that'll calm it!

miss.narr: You sip the broth. It does not calm it.

0.tip: 太辣了 = too spicy! 太…了 is "too…".

say.en: Tell her what you ordered was mild, not extra hot.
answers: 我点的是微辣，不是特辣！
say.gloss: I ordered mild, not extra hot!
say.tip: 我点的是…… = what I ordered was... 微辣 wēilà = mild, 中辣 = medium, 特辣 tèlà = extra hot.

mistakes.note: 订 dìng is for booking a table or a ticket. Ordering food is 点 diǎn.

ok.zh: 哎呀，上错了！这锅是隔壁桌的！
ok.en: Oh no, wrong pot! This one's for the next table!

ok.zh: 难怪！我这锅一点都不辣！
ok.en: No wonder! Mine isn't spicy at all!

fail.zh: 你点的什么？我看看单子。
fail.en: What did you order? Let me check the slip.

miss.en: Extra hot's extra hot. Eat up!
You finish the extra-hot pot, in tears. The next table films the whole thing. 📱
miss.zh: 你含着泪吃完了一锅特辣，隔壁桌全程录像。

0.tip: 我点的微辣 = I ordered mild (点 diǎn = order food). 微辣 wēilà = mildly spicy, the lowest heat on a Chongqing menu.

steps.narr: The pot goes. The burning stays. 😭
steps.zh: 锅端走了，可嘴还麻着，眼泪直流。

say.tip: 来 + measure word + thing is how you order: 来瓶牛奶 = a bottle of milk, please. 有……吗 = have you got...?

mistakes.note: 奶牛 nǎiniú is a dairy cow. Milk is the other way round: 牛奶 niúnǎi.

alts.en: Or: fight fire with an ice-cold beer

then.zh: 冰啤酒配火锅，会吃！来，走一个！
then.en: Ice-cold beer with hotpot: you know your stuff! Cheers!

ok.zh: 牛奶没有，给你拿瓶豆奶！
ok.en: No milk, but I'll grab you a soy milk!

miss.en: Huh? More chilli? You got it!

steps.zh: 油碟来了！香菜给你多放点哈？
steps.en: Here's your oil dip! Extra coriander, yeah?

say.en: No coriander. None. Not one leaf.
say.tip: 不要香菜 = no coriander: possibly the most useful sentence in China. 千万别…… = whatever you do, don't...

mistakes.note: 没有香菜 means 'there's no coriander'. To refuse it: 不要香菜, or 别放香菜.

ok.zh: 不要？给我！我最爱香菜了！
ok.en: You don't want it? Give it here! I love the stuff!

miss.en: Right, a double helping of coriander!

steps.narr: Your mild pot arrives at last. It is every bit as red as the first one. 🌶️
steps.zh: 你的微辣锅终于来了，跟刚才那锅一样红。

say.en: Look at the pot. Ask her: you call this mild?
say.tip: 这也叫……？ = you call this...?: pure disbelief. 这哪儿是…… = this is no...

alts.en: Or: give up and ask for plain broth
answers: 算了，给我换个清汤锅吧。
alts.gloss: Forget it, switch it to plain broth.

then.zh: 在重庆吃清汤锅？朋友，你是来喝汤的吧！
then.en: Plain broth, in Chongqing? Friend, did you come here for soup?

ok.zh: 对呀！重庆的微辣，就是这样的嘛。
ok.en: Sure is! That's what mild looks like in Chongqing.

miss.en: What are you staring at? It's mild, tuck in!

steps.en: Chongqing, lesson one: 'mild' here is everyone else's extra hot. Keep the soy milk close.
steps.zh: 在重庆，微辣就是外地的特辣。
